mapper.sql: work_shifts.id AS id, work_shifts.name AS `name`, work_shifts.time_from AS timeFrom, work_shifts.time_to AS timeTo, work_shifts.duration, description AS description, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy, CONCAT(modifier.first_name, ' ', modifier.last_name) AS modifiedBy, work_shifts.created AS created, work_shifts.modified AS modified
FROM work_shifts LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = work_shifts.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = work_shifts.modified_by
WHERE work_shifts.is_active = 1 AND work_shifts.`name` LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%")
mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, `name` AS name FROM work_shifts WHERE is_active = 1 AND `name` LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}
SELECT id AS id, `name` AS name FROM work_shift_types WHERE is_active = 1 AND `name` LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT late_check_in_time AS lateCheckingTime, leave_early_time AS leaveEarlyTime, beginning_check_in AS beginningCheckIn, ending_check_in AS endingCheckIn, beginning_check_out AS beginningCheckOut, ending_check_out AS endingCheckOut,
WHERE work_shifts.is_active = 1 AND work_shifts.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_shifts ( work_shift_type_id, `name`, time_from, time_to, duration, late_check_in_time, leave_early_time, beginning_check_in, ending_check_in, beginning_check_out, ending_check_out, description, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{workShift.workShiftType}, #{workShift.name}, #{workShift.timeFrom}, #{workShift.timeTo}, TIME(#{workShift.timeTo}) - TIME(#{workShift.timeFrom}), #{workShift.lateCheckingTime}, #{workShift.leaveEarlyTime}, #{workShift.beginningCheckIn}, #{workShift.endingCheckIn}, #{workShift.beginningCheckOut}, #{workShift.endingCheckOut}, #{workShift.description}, NOW(), #{creatorId}, 1 )
INSERT INTO work_shift_days ( work_shift_id, day_id, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{workShiftId}, #{dayId}, NOW(), #{creatorId}, 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT days.id AS id, days.`name` AS `name`, days.is_active AS isActive FROM work_shift_days LEFT JOIN `days` on `days`.id = work_shift_days.day_id WHERE work_shift_days.is_active = 1 AND work_shift_days.work_shift_id = #{workShiftId}
